changeHypothesis.summary: ABB and GE Vernova confirmed a real global power-equipment backlog cycle, and 思源电气 had the strongest Q1 A-share earnings conversion. However, by the Apr30 cutoff the entire frozen A-share opportunity basket had underperformed CSI300 over both 20 and 60 days with 0% positive breadth. V0.9 therefore keeps the industry hypothesis high priority but makes no stock selection.
